description: Good defaults derived from the probe layout by EphysPipelineConfig.ks4ProbeDefaults. 64 sites on 4 shanks: rows 10 um apart, lateral spacing 17.32 um, nearest contact 20 um.

reasons.nblocks: 64 sites, at most 64: drift estimates are unreliable, so no drift correction
reasons.dmin: median spacing of the contact rows within a shank
reasons.dminx: median lateral distance to the nearest contact in another column
reasons.nearest_chans: default, no more than the number of sites
reasons.nearest_templates: default, no more than the number of sites
reasons.min_template_size: nearest contacts 20 um apart: the default covers them
